summary: Commit authorization for phase 2 of review-flexibility. The change makes the reviewer route override reachable through the public workflow apply path (new review-dispatch submission, honest offer advertisement, plan-field continuation threading, request-scoped crash-window semantics), documents the outage procedure in the reviewing skills and the config overrides section in init, adds the upgrade carve-out, closes a one-line pre-existing status provenance type gap, and ships the matching tests plus the rebuilt tracked bundle. Nineteen repository paths: five source files (contracts, schema, two state modules, status types), six skill files, five test files (one new journey suite), three bundle artifacts. Verification fully green (typecheck; 1165 unit, 502 contract, 221 integration after the bundle rebuild, 34 crash tests; offline release check), with the pre-rebuild stale-bundle failure recorded in the transcript. Independent review is complete: the dispatched counter-review and a same-side fresh-context review both returned zero findings, and the constitution review gate was approved by the human. The commit lands on the feature branch from base 4f58174; task workflow records stay out of it per the usual durable-state follow-up.
